title: Console sketchpad weekly brief — UI / rollouts / analytics
content:
Meeting: Console Sketchpad weekly brief — focus: UI polish, rollout rehearsals, analytics gaps
Date: 2026-12-18 (notes updated 2026-12-20)
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Maya, Luca, Samira, Tony (observability), Janel (QA)

Purpose: quick sync to capture blockers, align on the canary+fallback plan for the panel rollout, and identify telemetry deltas to investigate before holiday freeze. This doc is deliberately rough — use as working source for follow-ups.

Agenda:
- UI: small polish items, hotspot UX for A/B, accessibility quick wins
- Rollouts: canary schedule, shadow-config run, fallback route mapping
- Analytics: missing event shapes, sampling config, dashboard health
- Action items + owners + dates

Quick updates (by area)

1) UI (Maya / Ethan)
- Progress: new panel chrome landed on feature branch; pruning of legacy edit controls nearly complete. UX team validated hover states on 1440px and 1024px breakpoints.
- Known issues: input focus jumps when switching routes (seen in Edge, intermittent). Hypothesis: fast DOM re-render triggered by telemetry flush component.
- Short-term plan: revert last micro-optimization in panel-resizer (PR link above) and run smoke on canary. If focus stability improves, reintroduce with guarded flag.
- UX TODOs: keyboard nav audit, labels for 3 new toggles, add aria-describedby for tooltip content.

2) Rollouts (Priya / Luca)
- Canary plan: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 20% over 48 hours with automated rollback on error-rate spike >= 2x baseline or median latency + p90 latency delta > 120ms.
- Shadow-config: running today against internal staging for 6h window to capture request shapes and KV cache behavior. Aim to exercise long-context requests (seq len 8192) and small short-burst requests.
- Fallback mapping: routes that rely on previews will automatically fall back to legacy-model variant; need to confirm prefix cache invalidation behavior (see ENG-4123).
- Open question: do we enable graceful degradation for routes with streaming blobs? Samira to prototype a minimal chunked-fallback that streams summary then full when safe.

3) Analytics / Telemetry (Samira / Tony)
- Observed: telemetry ingestion dropped ~12% between 12/16-12/17; root cause appears to be sampler config change in prod (CE-2208).
- Short term: revert sampler to previous config and resubmit missing events via replay pipeline (priority flag set).
- Dashboard gaps: rollout-health dashboard missing 'canary user cohort' filter; Maya will supply sample user list for synthetic cohort by 12/19.
- Event shape drift: new panel-edge events missing 'route_version' field — causes join failures for rollout attribution. Action: add server-side enrich step to backfill for last 7 days (if replayed).

Blockers / Risks
- Focus-jump bug blocks sign-off for 5% canary in Edge. High friction for enterprise customers using keyboard navigation. (Blocker)
- Telemetry sampling change risk: until replay finishes, early canary metrics may undercount errors or latencies. Plan to hold aggressive ramp until replay confirms parity. (Risk)
- Release freeze window next week — any change that touches shared model routing needs explicit approval from SRE and Product.

Decisions made
- Hold 20% ramp until telemetry replay shows parity and focus-jump fix verified in Edge (decision 2026-12-18).
- Use shadow-config run to exercise long-context workloads and collect KV cache miss patterns; if miss rate > 3% on synthetic runs, we revert quantization profile for the variant.

Action items (owner — due)
- Maya: keyboard nav audit + PR with aria fixes — due 2026-12-20
- Ethan: revert panel-resizer micro-opt and deploy feature branch to staging smoke — due 2026-12-19
- Samira: replay missing telemetry (CE-2208) and post status to #console-telemetry — due 2026-12-19 EOD
- Luca: draft canary runbook with explicit rollback triggers and test checklist — due 2026-12-20
- Priya: coordinate SRE approval for canary window and confirm release freeze exceptions — due 2026-12-20
- Tony: add 'canary user cohort' filter to rollout-health dashboard + synthetic cohort injection job — due 2026-12-21

Notes / loose thoughts (brain dump)
- Consider adding a lightweight 'telemetry sanity' end-to-end check that runs before each ramp (small synthetic request that exercises streaming + long context). Could be a line in the canary runbook.
- For accessibility wins: quick win is increasing hit area of toggles — low risk, high value.
- Onboarding checklist for feature flags: add a mandatory telemetry instrumentation review item so sampling config drift gets caught earlier.

Links / references
- ENG-4123 (rollout routing / prefix cache invalidation)
- CE-2208 (telemetry sampler change — rollback + replay)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2897 (panel chrome)
- Confluence: telemetry design notes (see linked_artifacts)

Next sync: light check-in 2026-12-20 10:00 PST (pre-canary gating) — focus on verification gates and final SRE sign-off.

If you're editing this doc: leave short comments inline and ping me on slack @priya for anything blocking the schedule.

Status: working draft; will convert to final runbook fragment once blockers cleared.
